real: M8 Armored Gun System / M10 Booker (XM35 105 mm with pepper-pot brake, coax M240, commander M2)
shape: refs: none; the old builder (mb_p27_wave1c): M8 AGS / M10 Booker light hull with a low 105 mm turret; 6.39 x 2.61 x 1.89 m with the gun (about 0.73 x the real M8); team bands on the roof and both sides; no real insignia.

features.feature: the welded box hull (Team), sloped glacis, lower nose plate
bolt-on Level II armour modules on the glacis and the hull sides with bolt rows
the driver's hatch on the centre line with three periscopes; lamps, hooks, front fenders
six road wheels, the rear sprocket, the front idler on its arm, a linked track
short skirts (four plates a side) with a rubber edge
engine deck louvres, the rear exhaust grille, tail lamps, tow cable
the low turret with flat bolted cheek modules and the bustle autoloader with blow-out panels
the bolted mantlet, the 105 mm gun, fume extractor and pepper-pot muzzle brake, the coax
the gunner's sight head, the commander's cupola with periscopes, the loader's hatch
the commander's M2 on a pintle over the cupola (roof-gun rule)
two three-tube smoke dischargers on the turret cheeks
stowage bins, racks, a tarp roll, toolboxes, water cans, whips, Team bands
